summary: CrossAmerica Partners LP filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its credit agreement with Citizens Bank, N.A. The amendment extends the maturity date to July 15, 2031, removes the SOFR credit spread adjustment, and tightens the Consolidated Leverage Ratio covenant from 5.00x to 4.75x over several quarters. This is a routine refinancing of existing debt, not a special situation event. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spinoff, liquidation, or other special-situation transaction is involved. The filing merely updates terms of a revolving credit facility and includes no price per share, premium, or advisor.
